title: AWS Systems Manager Incident Manager Contacts

operations.description: Used to acknowledge an engagement to a contact channel during an incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accept page [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts accept page [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] accept code info page receipt request result type validation

operations.description: Activates a contact's contact channel. Incident Manager can't engage a contact until the contact channel has been activated.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] activate contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts activate contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] activate activation channel code contact request result

operations.description: Contacts are either the contacts that Incident Manager engages during an incident or the escalation plans that Incident Manager uses to engage contacts in phases during an incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create contact [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts create contact [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] alias conflict contact create data encryption exceeded exception idempotency list name plan quota request result service tag tags token type

operations.description: A contact channel is the method that Incident Manager uses to engage your contact.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts create contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] activation address channel conflict contact create data defer encryption exception idempotency name request result token type

operations.description: Creates a rotation in an on-call schedule.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create rotation [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts create rotation [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] arn contacts create date exceeded exception id idempotency list name quota recurrence request result rotation service settings tag tags time token zone

operations.description: Creates an override for a rotation in an on-call schedule.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create rotation override [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts create rotation override [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] arn contacts create date exceeded exception idempotency list override quota request result rotation service time token uuid

operations.description: To no longer receive Incident Manager engagements to a contact channel, you can deactivate the channel.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] deactivate contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts deactivate contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] channel contact deactivate request result

operations.description: To remove a contact from Incident Manager, you can delete the contact. Deleting a contact removes them from all escalation plans and related response plans. Deleting an escalation plan removes it from all related response plans. You will have to recreate the contact and its contact channels before you can use it again.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete contact [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts delete contact [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] conflict contact delete exception request result

operations.description: To no longer receive engagements on a contact channel, you can delete the channel from a contact. Deleting the contact channel removes it from the contact's engagement plan. If you delete the only contact channel for a contact, you won't be able to engage that contact during an incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts delete contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] channel contact delete request result

operations.description: Deletes a rotation from the system. If a rotation belongs to more than one on-call schedule, this operation deletes it from all of them.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete rotation [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts delete rotation [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] conflict delete exception request result rotation

operations.description: Deletes an existing override for an on-call rotation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete rotation override [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts delete rotation override [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] delete override request result rotation uuid

operations.description: Incident Manager uses engagements to engage contacts and escalation plans during an incident. Use this command to describe the engagement that occurred during an incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] describe engagement [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts describe engagement [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] content data date describe encryption engagement exception id incident public request result sender subject time

operations.description: Lists details of the engagement to a contact channel.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] describe page [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts describe page [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] content data date describe encryption exception id incident page public request result sender subject time

operations.description: Retrieves information about the specified contact or escalation plan.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] contact [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts contact [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] alias contact data encryption exception name plan request result type

operations.description: List details about a specific contact channel.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] activation address channel contact data encryption exception name request result status type

operations.description: Retrieves the resource policies attached to the specified contact or escalation plan.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] contact policy [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts contact policy [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] contact policy request result

operations.description: Retrieves information about an on-call rotation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] rotation [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts rotation [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] arn contacts date id list name recurrence request result rotation settings time zone

operations.description: Retrieves information about an override to an on-call rotation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] rotation override [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts rotation override [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] arn contacts date list override request result rotation ssm time uuid

operations.description: Lists all contact channels for the specified contact.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list contact channels [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list contact channels [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] channel channels contact data encryption exception list max pagination request result results token

operations.description: Lists all contacts and escalation plans in Incident Manager.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list contacts [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list contacts [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] alias contact contacts list max pagination request result results token type

operations.description: Lists all engagements that have happened in an incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list engagements [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list engagements [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] engagement engagements id incident list max pagination range request result results time token

operations.description: Lists all of the engagements to contact channels that have been acknowledged.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list page receipts [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list page receipts [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] list max page pagination receipt receipts request result results token

operations.description: Returns the resolution path of an engagement. For example, the escalation plan engaged in an incident might target an on-call schedule that includes several contacts in a rotation, but just one contact on-call when the incident starts. The resolution path indicates the hierarchy of escalation plan > on-call schedule > contact.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list page resolutions [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list page resolutions [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers next security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] contact list page pagination request resolution resolutions result token

operations.description: Lists the engagements to a contact's contact channels.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list pages by contact [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list pages by contact [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] by contact list max page pages pagination request result results token

operations.description: Lists the engagements to contact channels that occurred by engaging a contact.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list pages by engagement [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list pages by engagement [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] by engagement list max page pages pagination request result results token

operations.description:
Returns a list of shifts based on rotation configuration parameters.

The Incident Manager primarily uses this operation to populate the Preview calendar. It is not typically run by end users.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list preview rotation shifts [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list preview rotation shifts [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] date id list max member override pagination preview recurrence request result results rotation settings shift shifts time token zone

operations.description: Retrieves a list of overrides currently specified for an on-call rotation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list rotation overrides [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list rotation overrides [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] date list max override overrides pagination request result results rotation time token

operations.description: Returns a list of shifts generated by an existing rotation in the system.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list rotation shifts [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list rotation shifts [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] conflict date exception list max pagination request result results rotation shift shifts time token

operations.description: Retrieves a list of on-call rotations.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list rotations [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list rotations [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] list max name pagination request result results rotation rotations token

operations.description: Lists the tags of an escalation plan or contact.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list tags for resource [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts list tags for resource [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] amazon for list name request resource result tag tags

operations.description: Adds a resource policy to the specified contact or escalation plan. The resource policy is used to share the contact or escalation plan using Resource Access Manager (RAM). For more information about cross-account sharing, see Setting up cross-account functionality.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] put contact policy [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts put contact policy [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] conflict contact exception policy put request result

operations.description: Sends an activation code to a contact channel. The contact can use this code to activate the contact channel in the console or with the ActivateChannel operation. Incident Manager can't engage a contact channel until it has been activated.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] send activation code [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts send activation code [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] activation code data encryption exceeded exception quota request result send service

operations.description: Starts an engagement to a contact or escalation plan. The engagement engages each contact specified in the incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] start engagement [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts start engagement [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] content data encryption engagement exception id idempotency incident public request result sender start subject token

operations.description: Stops an engagement before it finishes the final stage of the escalation plan or engagement plan. Further contacts aren't engaged.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] stop engagement [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts stop engagement [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] engagement reason request result stop

operations.description: Tags a contact or escalation plan. You can tag only contacts and escalation plans in the first region of your replication set.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] tag resource [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts tag resource [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] amazon exceeded exception list name quota request resource result service tag tags

operations.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] untag resource [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts untag resource [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] amazon key list name request resource result tag untag

operations.description: Updates the contact or escalation plan specified.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update contact [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts update contact [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] contact data encryption exceeded exception name plan quota request result service update

operations.description: Updates a contact's contact channel.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update contact channel [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts update contact channel [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] address channel conflict contact data encryption exception name request result update

operations.description: Updates the information specified for an on-call rotation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update rotation [PATH] x amz target ssm contacts update rotation [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed target token x [SCHEMA] arn conflict contacts date exception id list recurrence request result rotation settings time update zone
